## Relationships

### [Grace](../character/grace.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/adella--grace.md)

Adella and [Grace](../character/grace.md) are schoolmates and close companions who maintain a friendly relationship. During a period when their father is away and [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) is bedridden, [Grace](../character/grace.md) and [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) attempt to clean their house, though they accidentally cause a local scandal by beating carpets in the cemetery on a Sunday by mistake.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE P10](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0010), [v5 CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE P26](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0026), [v5 CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE P35](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0035), +2 more_
